_comment: Copy to tenants.json and edit by hand. tenants.json is gitignored.
secretHash is exactly 64 hexadecimal HMAC-SHA256 characters of the API secret
under the server key (hex letter case is ignored) — not a
slow KDF, which is why the service refuses to start on an unsafe backend.
_origins lists the browser origins allowed to read this tenant's responses.
Rename it to origins to switch browser access on; entries must be lower case,
scheme://host[:port] with no path or trailing slash, or the boot is refused.
The same underscore trick applies to _rpc: every endpoint listed under a real
rpc key is resolved at startup, and a placeholder host that does not resolve
refuses the boot. Rename _rpc once the URLs are real ones.
